misses.evidence: review-plan.json functions.not_asked + explicit rule_gaps; db.json physical pins/nets; TPS65023B p5-8,p11-13,p18,p40-43. This is a rule-plan/model miss, not a confirmed original-board electrical defect.

proposed_fix.what: 官方L1/L2/L3开关脚和VDCDCx输出须进语义端口模型；逐输出展开Cout/ESR与时序，不把固定22u当硬最大。
